shared_brief: SEAM: a private mobile notebook for freelance writers. Collect scattered phrases into one short daily draft, without streak pressure. No text, stars, sparkles, infinity loops, mascots or device mockups. Ink #173E48 main structure, coral #EF795F identifying feature, warm paper #F6EEE4 full background. Recognize at 32/48px among other apps. Palette is advisory raster intent.

references.label: Shared construction reference: consistent curve and spacing rules
references.observations: Four broad curved pieces share rounded terminals and a narrow central gap. Apply shared curve and gap consistency only; do not copy the four-piece cross, palette, or signature contour. This context is identical for both candidates.
